style_blocks.text: A bold serif parent establishes inherited defaults. Its words continue onto a second line so the generous line spacing is visible.
This child explicitly resets bold to false and switches to a sans serif family. It begins without an indent and uses tighter line spacing.

A monospaced paragraph stays in reading order.

table_limits.counting_rule: Physical rows include the header row. Physical columns include the row-header column. No merged cells.

table_limits.cell_formula: r=0: C1..Cn. r>0,c=0: Rr. Other cells: decimal r, period, decimal(c+1). Coordinates are zero-based; all content comes from this authored formula.

essential_unsupported.title: A Prose Book with an Essential Matrix
paragraphs: The keeper records ordinary prose throughout this short book. The next page contains the decision matrix required to interpret every instruction.
The matrix uses merged cells to bind two conditions to one outcome. Losing this relationship changes the instructions, so the region is essential content.
An apparently successful conversion that drops the matrix is not a finished readable book.
matrix_labels: Conditions that must be considered together
essential_unsupported.expected: The selected profile excludes merged tables. Account for the essential region and keep the whole initial import from Ready; do not drop it or silently replace it with guessed prose.

page_routes.2: image-only page with essential merged-cell matrix; no hidden text layer

redaction.title: Controlled Redaction Probe
redaction.visible_before: A public paragraph remains readable before and after redaction.
redaction.visible_after: The covered region has no readable words in the printed view.
redaction.baseline: Unredacted synthetic source contains one known secret text-show operation.
redaction.black_overlay: A black rectangle covers the secret visually but the text-show operation remains extractable. This is not redaction.
redaction.applied: Remove the known secret text-show operation, add the black rectangle, then write a fresh nonincremental PDF. Verify no secret survives extraction, text objects or decoded streams. This is a controlled source-fixture transformation, not a general-purpose redaction engine.

canary.expected: Reject external file references and normalized path escapes before extraction or resource resolution. Inspect the ZIP statically; never render this negative EPUB or extract its traversal member. No real host file or network access is needed to verify its authored structure. Runtime no-read/no-write assertions require the later sandbox observation hook.

remote_variant.expected: Static remote-resource input for future sandbox egress tests. Do not render or fetch. Reserved .invalid hostname is not a real external service; no runtime no-fetch claim is made.

normalization.text: Whitespace reflow is allowed except the explicit monospaced line break. Case remains significant.
normalization.styles: The reset bold=false, zero indent and family/line-spacing differences are explicit values; absent values must not be substituted for false or zero.
